title: funk
blurb: Eight seconds of drum machine, programmed in Drumbit, a free pattern sequencer that runs in a browser tab. AAron built it and sent it in. The pattern sits around 152 beats per minute and repeats cleanly, which makes it the odd one out on a board built for one-shot noises: most buttons here are a single hit, and this one is a groove you let run. Good as a bed under a voiceover, a stream starting soon screen, or anything that needs filling while you talk.
origin: Programmed by AAron in Drumbit, a drum machine that runs in a browser, and sent in through the upload form.
